= Codegen v0 — producer-emitted .wasm fixture
:toc: preamble

Backs PRODUCTION-PATH.adoc Phase 0 **gate 2** ("Codegen v0 emits valid
wasm for `examples/01-single-module.twasm`, verifiable end-to-end by
`typed-wasm-verify`"). Same vendoring pattern as `../c5_real/`: the
in-tree producer's real output is checked in so the verifier is
exercised against bytes a producer actually emits, and the Rust test
suite (`tests/codegen_v0.rs`) gates it on every PR without needing the
producer's toolchain in CI.

== Corpus

[cols="1,2,3"]
|===
| File | Source | What it is

| `01-single-module.wasm`
  | `01-single-module.twasm`
  | Output of the `twasmc` codegen v0 producer (`src/codegen/`) on
    `examples/01-single-module.twasm`. A valid wasm module carrying the
    `typedwasm.ownership`, `typedwasm.regions`, and
    `typedwasm.access-sites` custom sections. Verifies `Ok` under
    `verify_from_module` (L7/L10/L13) and clean under
    `verify_access_sites_from_module` (L2).
|===

The `.twasm` source is copied here verbatim from `examples/` so the
fixture is self-contained.

== Provenance

Reproducible from the paired `.twasm` source:

[source,shell]
----
# from repo root; toolchain: Zig 0.16.0 (pip install ziglang==0.16.0)
( cd src/codegen && zig build )
src/codegen/zig-out/bin/twasmc \
  < examples/01-single-module.twasm \
  > crates/typed-wasm-verify/tests/fixtures/codegen_v0/01-single-module.wasm
----

or via the convenience recipe `just codegen-example-01`.

Captured 2026-05-30 against:

* `twasmc` at `src/codegen/` (codegen v0)
* Zig `0.16.0` (`python -m ziglang version`)

The emission is deterministic: the same source + the same `twasmc`
yields byte-identical output. If `twasmc`'s codegen changes the wire
shape, regenerate this fixture in the same commit (the
`tests/codegen_v0.rs::*` assertions on region/access-site counts will
otherwise fail).

== Why vendored?

The verifier crate's blocking CI (`e2e.yml` job `cargo-verify`) is
Rust-only and does not provision a Zig toolchain. Vendoring the bytes
keeps the end-to-end gate fast and reproducible while the producer
itself stays buildable and documented under `src/codegen/`. Zig builds
do run in CI's non-blocking `build-e2e` job, but that pins Zig 0.15.1
and is advisory; `twasmc` targets 0.16.0, so it is intentionally not
wired into that job.

== Scope (v0)

This fixture covers L1-L6 single-module typed access exactly as far as
`examples/01-single-module.twasm` exercises it (region schema, embedded
`@Vec2`, `opt<@Players>` nullable reference, fixed `u8[24]` array,
`region.get`/`region.set` incl. nested `.pos.x`, `region.scan`, `if`/
`else`, and `is_null`). The remaining examples (`02`-`06`) and full
`spec/grammar.ebnf` coverage are Phase 1 producer work.
